title: the seven rest on one finite structure — a machine-checked theorem of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit
description:
the seven rest on one finite structure, declared in src/proof/index.lean and accepted by the Lean 4 kernel, sorry-free and axiom-free, closing by by decide.

Statement (Lean):

((List.range' 1 9).all (fun d => refl (refl d) == d)) ∧ (((List.range' 1 9).filter isUnit).length = 6) ∧ (span.eraseDups.length = 6)

Statement (LaTeX):

\forall d \in \{1,\dots,9\},\; \mathrm{refl}\mathopen{}\left(\mathrm{refl}\mathopen{}\left(d\right)\right) = d \land \left|\{\, x \in \{1,\dots,9\} \mid \mathrm{isUnit}\mathopen{}\left(x\right) \,\}\right| = 6 \land \left|\operatorname{dedup}\left(\mathrm{span}\right)\right| = 6

What this record establishes. A dated, public, citable deposit of this declaration and its proof, recomputable from the source it names. That is priority. It is not a claim that the result is unknown to the literature: prior art for this file is recorded in src/proof/priorart.lean as unclassified — no prior-art search has been performed, so no novelty is asserted.

Scope. The declaration is decided over a finite domain by exhaustion. It settles no Clay Millennium Problem and claims no quantum speedup. 0/7.
